# Get IP Address

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the devices IP address.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getIP(source: <#Enumeration (WFIPAddressSourceOption) (Optional)#>, type: <#Enumeration (WFIPAddressTypeOption) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getIP(source: External, type: IPv4)
~~~~
